content.text: ## Step 2: Install the pre-push hook

arguments.code:
result = await mcp.call_tool("tools", "ox-bridge-write", {"path": "/workspace/push-demo/work/.git/hooks/pre-push", "content": "#!/usr/bin/env bash
#
# pre-push hook: block pushes to refs/heads/main unless every outgoing
# commit has a subject of at most 72 chars and no 'WIP' (case-insensitive).
#
# stdin: one line per ref update: <local-ref> <local-sha> <remote-ref> <remote-sha>

set -u

ZERO=0000000000000000000000000000000000000000
MAX_SUBJECT_LEN=72
status=0

while read -r local_ref local_sha remote_ref remote_sha; do
    # Only police pushes targeting main
    [ "$remote_ref" = "refs/heads/main" ] || continue

    # Branch deletion: nothing to inspect
    [ "$local_sha" = "$ZERO" ] && continue

    # Outgoing range:
    #  - new branch (remote sha is all zeros): every commit reachable from local tip
    #  - otherwise: commits in remote..local (i.e. what this push would add)
    if [ "$remote_sha" = "$ZERO" ]; then
        range="$local_sha"
    else
        range="$remote_sha..$local_sha"
    fi

    # %H%x00%s -> "<sha>\0<subject>", robust even if the subject contains spaces
    while IFS= read -r line; do
        sha="${line%%$'\x00'*}"
        subject="${line#*$'\x00'}"

        problems=""

        if [ "${#subject}" -gt "$MAX_SUBJECT_LEN" ]; then
            problems+=" subject longer than ${MAX_SUBJECT_LEN} chars (${#subject})"
        fi

        if [[ "${subject,,}" == *wip* ]]; then
            problems+=" subject contains 'WIP'"
        fi

        if [ -n "$problems" ]; then
            echo "REJECTED $sha ('$subject'):$problems" >&2
            status=1
        fi
    done < <(git log --format='%H%x00%s' "$range")
done

if [ "$status" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "" >&2
    echo "pre-push: push to main blocked. Fix the commit(s) above, e.g.:" >&2
    echo "    git commit --amend -m 'a proper subject'" >&2
    echo "or use 'git rebase -i' for older commits." >&2
fi

exit "$status"
"})
print(result)

## What was built

**Hook**: `/workspace/push-demo/work/.git/hooks/pre-push`

- Reads stdin lines `<local-ref> <local-sha> <remote-ref> <remote-sha>` per git's pre-push contract
- Only acts when `remote-ref` is `refs/heads/main`; skips branch deletions
- Computes the outgoing range:
  - new branch (all-zero remote SHA) → all commits reachable from local tip
  - otherwise → `remote_sha..local_sha` (exactly what the push would add)
- Rejects any outgoing commit whose subject is >72 chars or contains `WIP` (case-insensitive), reporting SHA + subject to stderr with exit 1
- Uses `%H%x1f%s` as the log format — a lesson learned during testing: bash `read` strips NUL bytes, so `%x00` silently failed to split
